Kizimkazi dolphin tour

3–4 hours • Kizimkazi

Kizimkazi on Zanzibar's southeast coast is the only place in East Africa where you can see wild bottlenose dolphins in their natural habitat. We only work with operators certified by the Zanzibar Mari

Jozani Forest & red colobus walk

2–4 hours • Jozani Chwaka Bay National Park

Venture into Jozani Chwaka Bay National Park, Zanzibar's only national park. Walk guided forest trails to see the endangered rare red colobus monkey (endemic to Zanzibar), plus blue monkeys, bushbabie

$12–$98 per person Details & Booking
NAT

Kuza Cave + seaweed farm

3–5 hours • Jambiani / Paje

Descend into Kuza Cave — a series of freshwater caverns near Jambiani — then visit a working seaweed farm to learn about Zanzibar's second-largest export crop.

$25–$130 per person Details & Booking
